		"QAndA_Answer_8"		"Yes! The cards of eliminated players will be returned to the card pool for other players to draw."

		"QAndA_Answer_9"		"The game rewards are based on the number of games played and the rank of the player.<br>However, as the player play more matches, the rewards such as Gold and Battle Pass EXP will decrease."

		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_HeroLevel_Content"		"The hero starts at level 1; Whenever a sect upgrades its star level, the hero also gains 1 level.<br>When the sect star level increases, it provides a fixed amount of health: reaching 1/2/3/4 stars corresponds to providing {Enum:HEALTH_PER_LEVEL.1}/{Enum:HEALTH_PER_LEVEL.2}/{Enum:HEALTH_PER_LEVEL.3}/{Enum:HEALTH_PER_LEVEL.4} HP.<br>Upon reaching certain levels, the hero will learn a new talent.<br>"
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_Buff_Content"		"Buff statuses are categorized into【Shield】, 【Fury】, and【Chaos Points】.<br>【Shield】 reduces the hero's damage taken by a fixed amount, decaying each time damage is resisted, and countered by 【Vulnerability】.<br>【Fury】 increases the hero's attack speed and mana regeneration, decaying every second and negated by【Frost】.<br>After accumulating {Enum:ChaosThreshold} Chaos Points, enemy takes {Enum:ChaosDamage} Chaos damage."
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_Debuff_Content"		"Negative status include 【Poison】,【Frost】and【Vulnerability】.<br>【Poison】causes the enemy to continuously receive poison damage, which can not be evaded or result in critial strike.<br>【Frost】decreases the enemy's attack speed and mana regeneration, and the stacks decrease per sec, cancelling out with 【Fury】.<br>【Vulnerability】increases the damage dealt to the enemy by a fixed amount, and the stacks decrease each time taking effect, cancelling out with 【Shield】."
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_stun_Content"		"During the stun, the hero is prevented from using their passive, ultimate, and normal attacks."
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_BuffRule_Content"		"1. The event of applying status will still be triggered when the statuses cancel each other out.<br>2. 【Shield】and【Vulnerability】are classified as damage adjustment and are calculated before the final damage is settled; will not be affected by critical strike, damage reduction and other effects."
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_OtherBuff_Content"		"{Info:Buff_Lifesteal}{Info:Buff_AbilityLifesteal}{Info:Buff_Poison}{KeyWord:StrongShield}{KeyWord:PermanentShield}{KeyWord:PermanentInjury}{KeyWord:PermanentFury}{KeyWord:PermanentIce}"
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_DamageTypeNone_Content"		"[Drain Damage] cannot be evaded, cannot critically strike, and does not trigger on-hit effects. However, it is still affected by damage modifiers from Vulnerability and Shield."
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_Physical_Content"		"Physical damage can be evaded or critically struck, and is affected by damage adjustments from 【Vulnerability】 and 【Shield】. Each hero has a unique base critical chance and evasion rate."
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_Magical_Content"		"【Magic Damage】can not be evaded and result in critical strike by default, but it is still subject to damage adjustments from 【Vulnerability】and【Shield】."
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_Poison_Content"		"【Poison Damage】can not be evaded or result in critical strike, but it is still subject to damage adjustments from 【Vulnerability】and【Shield】."
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_Pure_Content"		"【Pure Damage】can not be evaded or result in critical strike, is not subject to damage adjustments from 【Vulnerability】and【Shield】, and is not shared by wards, but will be negated by certain status such as 【Invulnerability】."
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_Chaos_Content"		"【Chaos Damage】 is not affected by damage modifications from 【Shield】 and 【Vulnerability】 , cannot be critically struck, and can trigger evasion through 【Evade-Sect: Magic Deviation】"
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_DamageSpeedup_Content"		"Damage dealt by the hero (physical, magical and poison) will be increased by 6% per sec after more than 20 sec in the battle."
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_CourierDamage_Content"		"Damage to the Courier = Base damage + Win streak damage + Level damage, but it will not exceed the upper limit of that round.<br>Base damage = 2; Every 10 rounds +1 base damage.<br>Each win streak adds 1 win streak damage, up to 4.<br>Every 5 hero levels increases the level damage by 1.<br>Damage Limit Initial =6; After 10 rounds, +2 damage upper limit; Damage upper limit increases once every 5 rounds, for 6/8/10/12/50.<br><br>Turbo Mode:<br>The Courier starts with 20 HP<br>Damage to the Courier = Base damage + Win streak damage + Level<br>Courier deals 2 points of damage in rounds 1-9, each win streak adds 1 point of courier damage<br>Courier deals 4 points of damage in rounds 10-14, each win streak adds 2 points of courier damage<br>Courier deals 6 points of damage in round 15 and beyond, each win streak adds 3 points of courier damage<br>When the Courier reaches level 20, an additional 1 point of courier damage is added."
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_Greevil_Content"		"The Greevil is a scaling companion tied to your hero.<br>It features 3 distinct levels and gains a level for every 100 Greevil Energy accumulated.<br>Each level up evolves the Greevil's abilities and boosts the rarity of offerings in the Greevil Shop."
		"HandBook_Sub_Nav_GreevilEgg_Content"		"Choose from 4 types of Greevil Eggs, each providing a unique method to earn Greevil Energy.<br>Energy is also gained through passive accumulation where every 10 Interest yields 1 Greevil Energy, capped at 10 per round.<br><br>The Greevil hatches once you have accumulated 100 Greevil Energy."
